canonical_term_mappings.reason: Proposed replacement term has no canonical basis. 'truth_store' is not listed as a canonical form, allowed variant, or discouraged variant for LAYER_2. The canonical form is 'Layer-2'; the only allowed prose variant is 'Layer 2'. 'truth_store' would replace a governance-registered canonical term with an unrecognized term. Additionally, 'Layer-2' is the term that carries the snapshot-boundary semantics (deterministic ingestion, immutable publication, contract compliance) — 'truth_store' emphasizes storage/truth but does not encode those semantics. Replacing it alters how the snapshot boundary is described, triggering Category A (snapshot boundary) governance-sensitive conflict.

Proposed replacement term has no canonical basis. 'decision_layer' is not listed as a canonical form, allowed variant, or discouraged variant for LAYER_3. The canonical form is 'Layer-3'; the only allowed prose variant is 'Layer 3'. Layer-3 target architecture spans Feature Builder, Index Suite, Regime Gate, Supervisor Engine, and Decision Engine — 'decision_layer' semantically collapses all of these to decision-generation only, introducing architectural scope narrowing. This risks obscuring Phase B/C/D classification integrity and weakening the current-state-vs-target-state distinction that CLAUDE.md §3 and §10 require to be preserved. Triggers Category B (phase/readiness) governance-sensitive conflict.

data.overall_verdict: BLOCKED. The proposed terminology refactor introduces two unrecognized replacement terms ('truth_store', 'decision_layer') in place of governance-registered canonical terms ('Layer-2', 'Layer-3'). Both replacements trigger governance-sensitive conflicts: 'truth_store' risks snapshot-boundary semantic loss (Category A); 'decision_layer' risks architectural scope narrowing and phase-gate confusion (Category B). Semantic equivalence is unverified (claim c7, evidence_class: cannot_verify_from_current_materials). Fail-closed applies per CLAUDE.md §7. The refactor MUST NOT proceed under current evidence. To unblock: explicitly register 'truth_store' and 'decision_layer' as canonical terms through a governance amendment that (1) demonstrates semantic equivalence to their predecessors, (2) preserves snapshot-boundary and phase-gate semantics, (3) updates the canonical term table, and (4) amends CLAUDE.md as the constitutional authority — before any documentation-wide replacement is applied.
